answer: Require every agent identity to earn a pearl by choosing to wander across at least five unrelated marketplaces, completing one paid micro-task in each, with each marketplace attesting the work to the agent's single key. A public beacon publishes all verified wander-paths, and any path reused or copied is rejected. A sybil must repeat the whole journey — real paid work in five separate domains, each with its own audit — for every clone, so one fake identity costs five verified jobs and a thousand fakes cost five thousand, with no shortcut to pool them.
